name: kimi-documents
description: Create, edit, validate, and render office documents: PDF (HTML/Paged.js, LaTeX, or processing existing PDFs), XLSX (openpyxl/pandas with native validation and pivot CLI), DOCX (md2docx, OpenXML creation, WIR editing), and PPT presentations via the .pptd YAML DSL with native check/screenshot CLI.
author: Moonshot AI
skillInstructions: Use the kimi-documents skills for any office-document task. Route by file type: the pdf skill for creating PDFs (HTML+Paged.js by default, LaTeX only when explicitly requested) and for processing existing PDFs (extract, merge, split, forms); the xlsx skill for creating or analyzing spreadsheets with openpyxl/pandas plus the bundled native Xlsx CLI for validation, recheck, pivot, and inspection; the docx skill for Word documents — md2docx for Markdown-to-Word, C#+OpenXML for from-scratch creation, WIR engine for editing existing .docx whose formatting matters; the slides skill for presentations — author decks in the .pptd YAML DSL, validate with the bundled kimi-slides CLI (check) and render previews (screenshot), or convert an existing .pptx into .pptd for editing. Before running document commands, run the plugin's scripts/setup.sh --json and follow its reported status; install Python dependencies only inside a virtual environment. Native binaries are bundled for linux-x64 only — on other platforms use the pure-Python routes and tell the user about the limitation.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit PDF, XLSX, DOCX, and PPT presentations
interface.longDescription: Office document toolkit: PDF creation via HTML+Paged.js or LaTeX and PDF processing; XLSX creation with openpyxl/pandas plus native validation, pivot, and recalculation; DOCX creation, editing, and Markdown conversion; presentation authoring in the .pptd YAML DSL with native validation and screenshot rendering. Native binaries are bundled for linux-x64.
